sources.snippet: Our text-to-text framework allows us to use the same model, loss function, and hyperparameters on any NLP task. T5-Base is the checkpoint with 220 million parameters.

sources.title: t5-base download | SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: t5-base is a pre-trained transformer model from Google's T5 (Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer) family that reframes all NLP tasks into a unified text-to-text format. With 220 million parameters, it can handle a wide range of tasks, including translation, summarization, question answering, and classification.
